c: Batch · Yield ≈ 750 g cooked (9 portions × 80 g)
Trim the breasts, pat dry, rub with the oil and season with the salt, pepper and thyme.
Roast on a rack at 180 °C convection for 18–22 min to a core of 75 °C.
Rest 10 min; blast-chill to \< 5 °C within 90 min; cover and label. Slice 5 mm against the grain; portion 80 g.
Slice 1.5 mm on the slicer; lay in one layer on a lined tray.
Bake at 160 °C convection for 6–8 min until the fat renders and the edges darken.
Drain on paper; the chips crisp as they cool. Store airtight.
Mix until smooth; decant into a squeeze bottle and label.
Toast the bread golden. Fry the fries at 175 °C for 3–4 min; salt.
Fry the egg in the oil with the yolk broken until fully set; season.
Spread 10 g mayo on each slice. Melt the kashkaval on slice 1 under the salamander, 30 s.
Layer 1: slice 1 with kashkaval, chicken, tomato, slice 2.
Layer 2: egg, lukanka chips, lettuce, slice 3 mayo side down.
Press lightly, secure with 4 skewers and cut diagonally into 4 triangles. Serve on a board, fries in a cone.
